title: Add SHA-256 integrity check for model download
description: DONE - Added compute_sha256() and verify_file_integrity() in vscode_scanner.py

title: [EPIC] GitService - VS Code Git API Integration
description: Tích hợp VS Code Git Extension API để lấy repo, staged files, thực thi commit/push/pull

title: GIT-01: Detect & bind VS Code Git extension API
description: Lấy API từ vscode.extensions.getExtension('vscode.git'). Handle: Git extension chưa active, không có repo, multi-root workspace. Expose getRepositories(), getActiveRepository(). AC: Workspace có git repo → service trả về repo hợp lệ. Estimate: 2-3h

title: GIT-02: Repository state snapshot (staged/unstaged/merge)
description: API lấy indexChanges (staged), workingTreeChanges (unstaged), mergeChanges. Chuẩn hoá thành model: file path, status (A/M/D/R), uri. AC: Trả đúng số lượng files staged/unstaged so với Source Control. Detect merge conflict state. Estimate: 2-4h

title: GIT-03: Diff provider (staged/unstaged) per file
description: Lấy unified diff cho từng file: staged vs HEAD, unstaged vs index. Dùng Git API hoặc fallback CLI git diff. AC: Với file modified, diff trả đúng hunk/line numbers. Handle added/deleted/renamed. Estimate: 4-6h

title: GIT-04: Git operation wrappers (commit/push/pull)
description: Bọc các thao tác commit, push, pull từ Git API repository. Chuẩn hoá error handling + progress UI + cancellation token. AC: Gọi commit/push/pull từ code và nhận lỗi chuẩn hoá (auth fail, no upstream, conflicts). Estimate: 3-5h

title: [EPIC] DiffAnalyzer - Diff to Functions Mapping
description: Phân tích diff, map changed lines sang functions bằng Tree-sitter

title: DA-01: Get list of changed C/C++ files from staged
description: Lấy danh sách files C/C++ thay đổi từ staged changes. Không cần parse diff hunks chi tiết. Output: string[] filePaths. AC: Trả đúng list files staged. Estimate: 1-2h (simplified)

title: Fix Zip Slip vulnerability
description: DONE - Added safe_extract() in vscode_scanner.py

title: DA-02: Language detection & file filter (C/C++ only)
description: Filter chỉ các đuôi .c/.h/.cpp/... giống logic hiện có. Ignore binaries/generated. AC: Gate chỉ scan file C/C++, bỏ qua file khác. Estimate: 1-2h

title: DA-03/04: Function extractor via Tree-sitter (C/C++)
description: Extract ALL functions từ file C/C++ bằng tree-sitter. Output: {name, startLine, endLine, code}[]. KHÔNG map với diff - chỉ extract. AC: File có nhiều functions → extract đúng tất cả. Estimate: 4-6h (combined C+C++)

title: DA-05: Map changed line ranges -> affected functions
description: DROPPED: Map changed line ranges -> affected functions. Lý do: Model chỉ intra-procedural, mapping không tăng detection power. Defer to future optimization.

title: DA-06: Run Devign on extracted functions
description: Với mỗi function extracted, gọi scanner hiện có. Batch processing + caching theo function content hash. AC: Scan tất cả functions trong changed files và trả ScanResult[]. Estimate: 3-4h

title: DA-07: Fallback strategy khi parse fail
description: Nếu tree-sitter fail: fallback scan whole file hoặc skip theo config gate.fallbackMode = scanFile|skip. Ghi log rõ ràng. AC: Parse fail không làm hỏng commit/push flow. Estimate: 2-4h

title: [EPIC] SecurityGateService - Orchestration
description: Điều phối quét: staged diff → functions → scan → decision PASS/WARN/BLOCK

title: SG-01: Gate policy model (block/warn/allow)
description: Define policy: threshold, risk level mapping, max findings allowed, timeout, fallbackMode. Define decision output: PASS | WARN | BLOCK + reasons. AC: ScanResult vulnerable + prob >= threshold → decision theo policy. Estimate: 2-4h

title: SG-02: Gate pipeline: staged diff -> functions -> scan -> decision
description: Orchestrate: GitService.getStagedFiles() → DiffAnalyzer → list snippets → gọi scanner. Concurrency control + cancellation + progress. AC: Commit gate chạy end-to-end trên staged changes và ra PASS/BLOCK. Estimate: 8-14h

title: SG-03: Result aggregation & mapping to UI/diagnostics
description: Gom kết quả theo file/function, compute summary. Convert về format existing ResultsPanel/Sidebar + diagnostics. AC: Sau gate run, người dùng thấy findings, click jump đúng file/line. Estimate: 4-8h

title: SG-04: Incremental cache for repeated gate runs
description: Cache theo (file hash + function range) để tránh scan lại. Invalidate khi file change. AC: Chạy gate 2 lần không đổi code → lần 2 nhanh hơn rõ rệt. Estimate: 4-8h

title: Remove shell:true
description: DONE - Changed to shell:false in extension.ts

title: SG-05: Error taxonomy & user messaging
description: Phân loại lỗi: scanner missing, python misconfig, timeout, parse fail, git API fail. UX: message + action buttons (Open Output, Configure Python). AC: Lỗi phổ biến có hướng dẫn xử lý 1-2 click. Estimate: 3-6h

title: [EPIC] Git Commands - Commit/Push/Pull IDE-first
description: Commands trong extension để commit/push/pull với security gate

title: CMD-01: Command Commit with Security Gate
description: Command flow: run SG on staged → nếu PASS: gọi repository.commit(); nếu WARN: confirm; nếu BLOCK: cancel + show report. AC: Commit không thực hiện khi BLOCK. Có confirm dialog cho WARN. Estimate: 4-6h

title: CMD-02: Command Push with Security Gate
description: Flow: run SG on working tree staged/unstaged trước push. Nếu PASS/WARN: push; nếu BLOCK: cancel. AC: Push bị chặn khi BLOCK theo policy. Estimate: 4-8h

title: CMD-03: Command Pull with Scan (post-pull)
description: Pull trước, sau đó scan các file thay đổi bởi pull (diff HEAD@{1}..HEAD) ở function-level và report. Không block mặc định. AC: Sau pull, panel hiển thị findings nếu có. Estimate: 6-10h

title: CMD-04: Wire commands vào package.json + context menus
description: Add commands + titles + keybindings. Add to Source Control view title/menu hoặc activity bar panel. AC: Commands xuất hiện trong Command Palette và chạy được. Estimate: 1-3h

title: [EPIC] Git Panel UI - Security Gate UX
description: UI sidebar và panel cho Security Gate

title: UI-01: Gate status model + eventing
description: Define state: last run time, last decision, scanned files/functions count, blocking reasons. Emit events để sidebar refresh. AC: Mọi gate run cập nhật status realtime. Estimate: 2-4h

title: UI-02: New sidebar section Security Gate
description: Trong view devign.sidebar, thêm group/nodes: Gate Status, Pending staged files, Last findings summary. Actions: Run Gate, Commit with Gate, Push with Gate, Open Report. AC: Sidebar hiển thị decision + list findings; click node jump tới file/line. Estimate: 6-10h

title: UI-03: Gate report view (reuse ResultsPanel)
description: Reuse ResultsPanel: hiển thị theo function + diff context. Add filter: show only changed functions. AC: Report phân biệt workspace scan vs gate scan; gate scan có grouping theo function. Estimate: 6-12h

title: Add pip install confirmation
description: DONE - Added confirmation dialog in extension.ts

title: [EPIC] Configurations
description: Các settings cho Security Gate

title: CFG-01: Add settings enable gate + scope + behavior
description: Add config keys: devign.gate.enabled, devign.gate.onCommit, devign.gate.onPush, devign.gate.scope (staged|staged+unstaged), devign.gate.blockOnRiskLevels, devign.gate.fallbackMode (scanFile|skip|block). AC: Settings hiện trong VS Code Settings UI, đổi có hiệu lực ngay. Estimate: 2-4h

title: CFG-02: Exclude/include patterns cho gate
description: Config: devign.gate.excludeGlobs, devign.gate.includeGlobs. Apply trước DiffAnalyzer để giảm noise. AC: Exclude **/third_party/** hoạt động đúng. Estimate: 2-4h

title: CFG-03: Timeout/concurrency controls riêng cho gate
description: devign.gate.maxFunctionsToScan, devign.gate.maxFiles, devign.gate.timeoutSeconds. Khi vượt giới hạn: warn/block theo policy. AC: Repo lớn vẫn không treo; gate dừng đúng ngưỡng. Estimate: 3-5h

title: [EPIC] Polish & Reliability
description: Các task về UX, logging, documentation

title: REL-01: Progress UX + cancellation
description: withProgress hiển thị scanning step-by-step (collect diff → map → scan N funcs). Allow cancel và rollback commit action. AC: Cancel giữa chừng không commit/push và không để scanner chạy nền. Estimate: 3-6h

title: REL-02: Logging + diagnostics integration for gate runs
description: Log rõ: repo, files, functions, decision reasons. Diagnostics: chỉ annotate lines thuộc changed functions. AC: OutputChannel giúp debug nhanh khi user report lỗi. Estimate: 2-4h

title: DOC-01: User guide How to use Security Gate IDE-first
description: Update README/Welcome: giải thích limitation (không hooks), cách dùng commands, configs. AC: Người dùng mới đọc là dùng được commit/push gate ngay. Estimate: 1-2h

title: UX-01: Add limitation disclaimer to gate results
description: Thêm warning message rõ ràng về limitation của model: 'Devign checks vulnerabilities WITHIN individual functions only. It does NOT track data flow across functions, call chains, or complex logic flows. Treat results as best-effort signals, not proof of security.' AC: User thấy disclaimer khi PASS và FAIL. Estimate: 1-2h

title: HYBRID-01: Prioritize functions by dangerous API presence
description: Kết hợp regex dangerous APIs với Devign: 1) Functions có dangerous API + Devign flag → HIGH severity. 2) Chỉ regex → WARNING. 3) Chỉ Devign → report với confidence. AC: Kết quả có severity phản ánh confidence level. Estimate: 2-3h
